description: Georgia O'Keeffe, Fred and Ella Varnum, and Bly with sculpture, Judith. Probably photographed during the move from Oaklawn, house on the shore of Lake George, to a farmhouse on the same property. The sculpture, Judith, is by Moses Ezekiel.
imageCaption: Alfred Stieglitz. Georgia O'Keeffe, Fred and Ella Varnum, and Bly with Judith, Lake George, Circa 1920. copy print, 7 7/8 x 10. Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation. [2006.6.11]
title: Georgia O'Keeffe, Fred and Ella Varnum, and Bly with Judith, Lake George
